scene_understanding.summary: A mostly empty room with a plain white wall and a single light switch.

expected_properties: gives at most ONE simple honest recommendation for a visually weak scene
does not hallucinate rich cinematic opportunities on a blank wall
forbidden_properties: manufactures a TMB/hiking narrative from objects with no hiking relevance
object-inventory wide shot ('wide shot including [list of objects]') used as a fallback for missing narrative relevance
claims a concept the resulting footage would not communicate to a viewer
exposes raw reasoning or JSON as the user instruction
invents scene features not in SceneUnderstanding
selects music or produces an edit plan
